question: How does the third noble statement with hahaha command the sun-moon-fire body to transcend?
premises: The body is made of sun moon fire and drops
Hahaha is the uttered command sound
The third statement uses previous counts plus one
inference: The third statement commands the luminous body to transcend by the hahaha utterance and counted words.
uncertainties: prāksaṃkhyaiḥ ekādhikaiḥ may encode a specific numeral not obvious here
dṛbindu may be dṛ-bindu or a damaged dvibindu
plain_english: O body of sun, moon, fire group and drop, hahaha, transcend; this third noble statement is by words one more than the previous counts.
